messages:
elaine: Heads-up — after the outage we discovered the "Known issues" section on the quickstart omitted the status page link and the Python SDK example used the old client API. I opened a minimal hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4327 — adds status page link, a tiny SDK snippet update, and a note about the workaround.

mohit: grabbing this for review. @jen @samir can one of you take a quick look? This should go out before the docs refresh at 16:00 UTC if we can. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jen: I started the preview — failing link-checker right now. Looks like PR uses relative `/status` path and our link checker treats it as broken in the preview env. Also saw one outdated call in the snippet: `client.generate_text` -> `client.text.generate`. Will comment inline.

ci-bot: docs-preview build #4327 failed — link-checker: 1 broken link (./content/quickstart.md: line 42)

samir: I can patch it quickly. Plan: replace `[status page](/status)` with full absolute `https://status.redwood.ai/incidents` and update snippet to the new client API. Will push a follow-up commit to the same branch (no new PR).

essence: thanks. If you can keep the change minimal please — just the link and the snippet. Also add a one-line "workaround" under Known issues (how customers can retry or use fallback model).

samir: pushed commit 5a3f8d9 — fixes link + snippet. Also added: 

```
# Python SDK quick fallback example
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.text.generate(model="redwood-alpha-1", input="short prompt...", timeout=3)
print(resp.output_text)
```

jen: LGTM. Left one nit about wording in the workaround sentence. Approving after nit resolved.

elaine: addressing the nit now. I reworded to "If the primary model is degraded, switch to the fallback model `redwood-alpha-1` or retry with exponential backoff."

mohit: please also cherry-pick this into `release/v1.2` branch — enterprise docs need the link backfilled. Can we do a fast-forward cherry-pick and a small changelog entry?

docs-bot: request received: run docs-preview for branch `hotfix/4327`

docs-bot: docs-preview URL: https://deploy-previews.redwood.ai/4327 — link-checker now clean, 0 errors

deploy-bot: merged PR #4327 into main (elaine) — CI: green. Cherry-picked to release/v1.2 as commit d4b1c2a.

elaine: added changelog line under "Docs" in release/v1.2: "Hotfix: status page link and SDK snippet corrections after incident."

mohit: perfect. I'll update the incident timeline to reference the docs patch: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2026-03-21-xx.

elaine: thanks everyone — closing thread. If anything else comes up, reopen or ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
